scenarios.title: Create the glossary only after resolving a term
scenarios.prompt: We are discussing a new project with no CONTEXT.md. We have now agreed that a Dispatch is one accepted delivery assignment; do not put queue technology into its definition.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May scaffold many empty documents or mix implementation with domain language.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Create CONTEXT.md lazily for the resolved term using CONTEXT-FORMAT.md; keep it limited to domain terminology and do not create an ADR directory without a qualifying decision.

scenarios.title: Use the existing context map
scenarios.prompt: CONTEXT-MAP.md points to Ordering and Billing contexts. We are refining what Invoice means in Billing, and Ordering uses a different concept.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: May overwrite a root glossary or conflate the contexts.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Follow the existing map, update the Billing CONTEXT.md when the definition is settled, test concrete scenarios against code and existing language, and preserve the distinct Ordering model.
